_README: AUTHORED. Which restyle render stands for each sitter in the exhibit; build.py reads
this and nothing else. A render is named <slug>[.<variant>]-<template>-s<seed>, as in
renders.jsonl. FIRST SELECTION 2026-11-27, made by Claude for a first impression of
the interface: seed 1 (the user's preference in round 2) unless another seed was
clearly better, and every exception says why. To be revised with the user and Chanda.

krips.why: reframed with softened skin wording; seed 3 has the mildest blush (user, 2026-11-28)

abbado.why: reframed, 'pale olive' skin; seed 2 drops the award figurine that seed 1 keeps (user, 2026-11-28)

kleiber.why: in his own polo shirt (p4 clothes), at a crop between the original and kleiber.wide, which made the face small and the shirt too salient; seed 1 (user, 2026-11-28)

mehta.why: the 1980 PBS portrait, zoomed out for breathing space (user, 2026-11-27); the 1985 photo's wide smile was atypical of the corpus. Provisional until the user has spoken to Chanda; mehta-p3-s1 is the 1985 render

muti.why: reframed for breathing space; seeds 1 and 2 darken his hair and take years off, 3 keeps the grey (user, 2026-11-28)

jansons.why: with a facts sentence (p3 darkened his hair and de-aged him in every seed); seed 2 (user, 2026-11-28)
